For example, if t = 3, then integers 13a13322, aaa, abcdef0123456789 are interesting, but numbers aaaa, abababab and 1000000 are not interesting.Your task is to find the k-th smallest interesting for Igor integer in the hexadecimal notation. The integer should not contain leading zeros.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print in the hexadecimal notation the only integer that is the k-th smallest interesting integer for Igor.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains the two integers k and t (1 ≤ k ≤ 2·109, 1 ≤ t ≤ 10) — the number of the required integer and the maximum number of times some integer or letter can appear in interesting integer. It can be shown that the answer always exists for such constraints.
